v0.4.5 — Time integrity and counterfeit navigation records
Two checks from the 2026 time-purity study of the spoofed Sulina station, run inside the EuroVeil monitoring platform.

- **Time integrity.** `result.time_integrity` flags data that claims to be observed after its file was written, or in the future. An offset of a whole number of 1024-week cycles is reported as a GPS week rollover, with the weeks to subtract; anything else as a false time source. It also counts backward and repeated epochs, gaps, event records and power-failure flags. On Sulina's files it reports a 2045-dated hour as one rollover and a 2028-dated hour as a false time source, 90 weeks after the file was written.
- **Counterfeit navigation records.** GPS records with an orbit and all nine perturbation terms zero are dropped when a navigation file is read. BKG's merged file of 1 January 2026 holds 276 of them among 779 GPS records, some 53,000 km off. Dropping them removed none of 457,593 genuine records from clean stations. `result.nav_records_dropped` reports the count.

```bash
pip install -U geoveil-cn0
```
